Paragraph: "Then all of the tree-branch animals, who are great in their strength, have wrecked down the well-flowered trees that are clumped in that forest on that mountain by their swinging..."
Situation/Problem_Faced: Collateral damage and destruction caused by panic-driven movement.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: The strong monkeys inadvertently break flowered trees in their frantic movement.
Outcome/Resolution: The surrounding forest bears the mark of their destructive panic.

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Kshobha (Agitated, disruptive emotional disturbance shaking one's environment)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Untamed strength driven by fear causes destruction to surrounding beauty rather than protection.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Disruptive behavior: unmanaged anxiety leading to accidental environmental damage and loss of fine control.
